legal.termsEffectiveDate: Effective from: 01/07/2024 • Version: 1.0 (Compliant with Vietnamese law)
legal.termsSection1Body: 9Paws is a technology application that supports personal expense tracking and group bill splitting. By downloading, installing, or using the application, you agree to comply with these Terms together with the applicable laws and regulations of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
legal.termsSection2Body: 9Paws is NOT a bank, credit institution, electronic wallet, or payment intermediary under Decree 52/2024/ND-CP. We do not open payment accounts, do not raise or hold user funds, and do not provide alternative money transfer services. All settlement and transfer activities are carried out by the users themselves directly between the parties through official banks.
legal.termsSection3Body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the expense figures entered into the application and for securing your personal device. All transaction records belong entirely to you.
legal.termsSection4Body: We commit to full transparency on all features with no hidden charges. Users have the right to close their account and permanently delete all data at any time without any obligation.
legal.termsSection5Body: Please send all questions and complaints to support@9paws.com. We commit to receiving and responding in accordance with applicable Vietnamese law.
legal.privacyComplianceNote: Complies with Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection (PDPD)
legal.privacySection1Body: 9Paws only collects the minimum information needed to operate your account: Full Name, Email address, phone number (if you provide it), and avatar. We ABSOLUTELY DO NOT collect national ID numbers, bank account details, banking passwords, or payment OTPs.
legal.privacySection2Title: 2. Rights of the Data Subject (Article 9 - Decree 13/2023/ND-CP)
legal.privacySection2Body:
You have full rights under the law over your data:
• The right to be informed and to consent to the purpose of data processing.
• The right to access and edit personal information in the Edit Profile section.
• The right to withdraw consent or refuse to enable biometric features or notifications.
• The right to request permanent deletion of all data and the account (Right to erasure).
legal.privacySection3Title: 3. Commitment Not to Share Data with Third Parties
legal.privacySection3Body: 9Paws pledges not to sell, rent, or share users' personal spending data with any advertising partner or credit organisation.
legal.privacySection4Body: All connections are encrypted using the standard HTTPS/TLS 1.3 protocol. Fingerprint/Face ID authentication data is processed entirely locally on the device's secure hardware (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore) and is never sent to the server.
legal.privacySection5Body: If you have any questions or wish to exercise your data subject rights, please contact the 9Paws Data Protection Department at privacy@9paws.com or support@9paws.com.
